entries.why: createTestDb() mints a per-call temp file named test-db-<uuid>.db (line 250) and copies this fully-migrated template database onto it (line 252), then opens a libsql client on that file (line 253); no reset, truncation or rollback is used because each caller receives its own database file

importing this helper binds the test to a real file-backed SQLite (libsql) database with every drizzle migration applied, not an in-memory or stubbed store; the helper's own header records that a temp FILE is used deliberately because libsql loses an in-memory database across a transaction commit
